snippet.title: Nomadic Lifeaholic
snippet.description:
Welcome to our channel, where nomadic life meets off-grid living, minimalism, and slow travel. Dive into the world of desert and mountain nomads, exploring homesteading, bushcraft, and the essence of a nomadic lifestyle. 

Our content celebrates village, rural, and mountain life, embracing organic, country living with a deep respect for nomadic culture. Discover the joys of farm life, village food, and traditional cooking, connecting with the simplicity of villagers, tribes, and the wild. 

Join us for a journey through the art of nomadic cooking, the beauty of primitive life, and the companionship of goats, sheep, horses, and tents. Our stories are a tribute to the nomadic lifeaholic spirit, offering insights into living in harmony with nature. 

Whether you're drawn to the allure of nomadic living, the principles of minimalism, or the skills of off-grid living and bushcraft, our channel is your guide to a life less ordinary. Embrace the nomadic, the wild, and the free with us.

snippet.title: Wilson Forest Lands
snippet.description:
My Patreon is at https://patreon.com/WilsonForestLands

Most of my videos take place on my own forest lands in Southwest Oregon. That is where my sawmill, the tiny house build and the new gravel road are. I sometimes also make videos at my property at the coast. (no I didn't inherit any of my land) 

A few of my videos take place on my family's ranch that was passed down to other family members from my great great grandfather. I don't own the ranch. I just like to go there sometimes, and occasionally work on projects there.

I get flooded with emails from people wanting me to review their products. This is not a review channel. I don't want to review your products. Not unless you have something amazing, like a tractor or a million billion zillion dollars for me to review.

snippet.title: Blackout Shelter
snippet.description:
Blackout Shelter — practical survival knowledge for the moments when modern life stops working.

This channel explores what really happens during blackouts, infrastructure collapse, supply shortages, civil unrest, and large-scale emergencies — and how to prepare before panic begins.

Every week, you’ll find realistic survival strategies, grid-down preparedness, EMP scenarios, nuclear fallout survival, bug-out planning, urban survival tactics, emergency gear breakdowns, off-grid systems, and hard truths about survival that most people ignore.

No fantasy survival roleplay.
No fear-driven clickbait.
Just clear information, real preparation, and practical systems that can actually keep you alive.

Whether you’re building your first emergency setup or improving an advanced preparedness plan, Blackout Shelter is built to help you stay ready when everything else fails.

No fear-driven clickbait.
Just clear information, real preparation, and practical systems that can actually keep you alive.

Whether you’re building your first emergency setup or improving an advanced preparedness plan, Blackout Shelter is built to help you stay ready when everything else fails.

snippet.title: Hawaiian Electric
snippet.description:
Inspired by an enlightened king more than a century ago, Hawaii was an early adopter of electricity to light homes and power industry. The ingenuity in creating and delivering power on these isolated islands is a unique story of innovation, connectivity and progressive thinking that continues today.

Hawaiian Electric serves 95 percent of Hawaii’s 1.4 million residents on the islands of Oahu, Maui, Hawaii, Lanai and Molokai. Established in 1891, Hawaiian Electric is committed to empowering its customers and communities by providing affordable, reliable, clean and sustainable energy.
